svg.text: Every code point where this interpreter’s nameprep mapping stage departs from the tables
RFC 3454 enumerates. One tick each, in code point order, nothing aggregated.
CPython 3.11.15 · RFC 3454, 17 enumerated tables · population 1,112,064 · deviating 684
87 were visible to last night’s census, which compared this component with a second implementation.
597 were not. The second implementation leaves the frozen repertoire the same way, so the two
agreed — and agreement was the evidence.

map_table_b3’s return code.lower() replaced by a lookup in the enumerated Table B.3 — nothing else touched
Fifteen of the seventeen tables match the RFC exactly. The two that deviate are the two the module computes instead of copying.
